## Tabla de resumen distribuciones discretas

<div style="font-size: 30px; margin-top: 70px;">

<table style="
width:100%;
border-collapse:collapse;
font-size:30px;
font-family:'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif;
box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(0,83,155,0.18);
border-radius:12px;
overflow:hidden;
">

<thead style="
background:linear-gradient(90deg,#0072B2,#00A6D6);
color:white;
">

<tr>
<th style="padding:14px 16px; text-align:center;">Distribución</th>
<th style="padding:14px 16px; text-align:center;">Parámetros</th>
<th style="padding:14px 16px; text-align:center;">Soporte</th>
<th style="padding:14px 16px; text-align:center;">Notación</th>
</tr>

</thead>

<tbody>

<tr class="fragment fade-up bg-white" data-fragment-index="1">
<td style="padding:13px 16px; font-weight:700; color:#005B96;">Bernoulli</td>
<td class="pad-13-16 text-center">$(p \in (0,1))$</td>
<td class="pad-13-16 text-center">$(\{0,1\})$</td>
<td class="pad-13-16 text-center">$\text{Ber}(p)$</td>
</tr>

<tr class="fragment fade-up" data-fragment-index="2" style="background-color:#EAF6FF;">
<td style="padding:13px 16px; font-weight:700; color:#005B96;">Binomial</td>
<td class="pad-13-16 text-center">$(n \in \mathbb{N}, p \in (0,1))$</td>
<td class="pad-13-16 text-center">$(\{0,1,\ldots,n\})$</td>
<td class="pad-13-16 text-center">$\text{Bin}(n,p)$</td>
</tr>

<tr class="fragment fade-up bg-white" data-fragment-index="3">
<td style="padding:13px 16px; font-weight:700; color:#005B96;">Poisson</td>
<td class="pad-13-16 text-center">$(\lambda > 0)$</td>
<td class="pad-13-16 text-center">$(\{0,1,2,\ldots\})$</td>
<td class="pad-13-16 text-center">$\text{Poi}(\lambda)$</td>
</tr>

<tr class="fragment fade-up" data-fragment-index="4" style="background-color:#EAF6FF;">
<td style="padding:13px 16px; font-weight:700; color:#005B96;">Geométrica</td>
<td class="pad-13-16 text-center">$(p \in (0,1))$</td>
<td class="pad-13-16 text-center">$(\{1,2,3,\ldots\})$</td>
<td class="pad-13-16 text-center">$\text{Geo}(p)$</td>
</tr>

<tr class="fragment fade-up bg-white" data-fragment-index="5">
<td style="padding:13px 16px; font-weight:700; color:#005B96;">Hipergeométrica</td>
<td class="pad-13-16 text-center">$(N,M,n)$</td>
<td class="pad-13-16 text-center">$(\{0,\ldots,\min(n,M)\})$</td>
<td class="pad-13-16 text-center">$\text{Hiper}(N,M,n)$</td>
</tr>

</tbody>
</table>
